items.label: la hanche
items.scene: A grandma with a brand-new HIP twirls a hula hoop round her HAUNCH ("AHNSH") by the fountain, grinning.

items.label: l'extrémité
items.scene: A patient stretched out on a lounger holds a little cup of TEA ("TAY") and wiggles his toes, the very EXTREMITY of his foot.

items.label: le soin
items.scene: A mother SWAN ("SWAN") takes gentle CARE of her eggs, fluffing her wings over the nest at the fountain's edge.

items.label: le miracle
items.scene: A MIRACLE ("mee-RAHKL"): a dry old rose bush beside a patient's bench has burst into flower overnight.

items.label: le dommage
items.scene: A toy robot with a dented arm comes in for repair, and the nurse tuts at the DAMAGE ("doh-MAHZH").

items.label: le repos
items.scene: A sleepy sloth takes his REST ("ruh-POH") in a hammock between two palms, in perfect REPOSE.

items.label: l'asile
items.scene: A robin family finds ASYLUM in a snug nest box, welcomed with ZEAL ("ah-ZEEL") by a gardener who holds the box up high.
